name: Neststuck
summary: Your name is John. As unpreviously mentioned, you are (unknowingly) a part of an evil scheme by Dirk Strider. He has made a new world to test his capabilities of universe creation. Combining his friends with the world of Angry Birds. A number of Bad Piggies have stolen your eggs. You have one slingshot and 10 Angry Birds with 10 unique abilities.
